items.article: HDFC Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank have appointed Anup Bagchi and Anup Kumar Saha as their new CEOs. The appointments stand out because both executives share ICICI Bank roots, IIT-IIM pedigrees and the same age. HDFC Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank have named new CEOs, and the two appointments have thrown up an unusual coincidence: both incoming chiefs are named Anup, are 55 years old, have studied at an IIT and an IIM, and spent a significant part of their careers at ICICI Bank. HDFC Bank has appointed Anup Bagchi as its Managing Director and CEO for a three-year term starting October 27, 2026. Kotak Mahindra Bank has appointed Anup Kumar Saha as its MD and CEO for three years from January 1, 2027. The similarities do not end with their first names. Both Bagchi and Saha are former ICICI Bank executives who went on to hold senior leadership positions elsewhere before being picked to lead two of India's largest private-sector banks. The coincidence was also highlighted by the Times of India, which reported that both are 55 years old and hail from West Bengal.
